name: The Rewritten Journal
source:
At nineteen, Atlas lost his life. He awoke next with his body housed inside a marble statue. Twenty years later, he's a shut-in watching the world-- and his friends-- go on  without him. But on his birthday, he's presented with the opportunity to change everything...

And create his own fantasy.

One where they can play pretend...

...forever.

[From [url=https://specter-of-you.itch.io/trwj]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
十九岁时，阿特拉斯去世了。接下来他醒来，发现自己的身体被安置在一座大理石雕像内。二十年后，他闭门不出，看着世界和他的朋友们在没有他的情况下继续生活。但在他生日那天，他得到了改变一切的机会……

并创造自己的幻想。

一个他们可以假装玩的地方……

…永远。

[来自[url=https://specter-of-you.itch.io/trwj]itch.io[/url]]
